name: Anti-Design
summary: Broken grids, clashing type, overlap, odd colour and deliberate roughness. It answers the polish of templated product sites and asks the visitor to notice the design.

philosophy.core_thesis: Polish is a lie: a page that breaks the rules on purpose shows that people made it.
design_principles: Break the grid on purpose: shift at least 3 elements by 12px to 80px off any column and overlap 2 or more blocks by 8px to 48px.
Mix at least 3 type families or 4 styles on one page and scale type by a ratio of 3 or more between neighbours.
Use 4 to 6 clashing colours, including 1 acid colour (#C6FF00 or #FF3B00), with saturation above 80%.
Rotate 2 to 5 elements by 3° to 15° and let text run at an angle or vertically.
Set at least one headline at 120px or larger and crop it by the viewport edge.
Place a raw or default element (system button, plain table) beside a styled one.
Make the navigation odd: a label in the wrong place, an icon with no text, or a link inside the headline.
anti_patterns: Centred symmetric layouts on a tidy grid
A single safe typeface and a safe palette
Cards of equal size with equal padding

layout.grid_mechanics: A broken grid: a 12-column base that elements leave by 12px to 80px; blocks overlap and stack in z-order.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 10% to 30% of the surface stays empty, and the empty space is uneven; the spacing scale is irregular on purpose: 6, 20, 44, 90px.
layout.alignment_rules: Mixed flush-left, flush-right and rotated; no common edge across sections.
layout.container_geometry: Mixed shapes: rectangles of 0px radius, one pill, one circle; borders of 2px to 6px in black or acid colour.

font_pairings.note: A tall, loud display with a mono text face.
A wide, round display with a technical text face.
A fat serif that clashes with a grotesque on purpose.

typography.tracking: Display takes -0.04em to +0.1em, varied by word; body stays at 0.
hierarchy_rules: Use two weights: regular (400) and bold (700).
Use at least 4 sizes with a jump of at least 3x between steps: 12, 36, 120 and 360px.
Mix upper case, lower case and italic in one headline.
Set at least one phrase as outline type with a 2px stroke.

color.palette_structure: Clashing hues on an off-white or black ground, with one acid colour.
color.contrast_rules: Black on chalk holds 18:1; body text never sits on an acid colour below 7:1; neon carries large type and blocks.
color.surface_treatment: Flat, opaque fields; occasional raw grain or a rough drawing; no soft gradient.
color.light_and_shadow: No light source; a hard offset of 6px 6px 0 black may appear on one element.

materiality.surface_simulation: Cut paper and rough digital collage; the surface is flat and does not imitate a material.
materiality.border_rules: Borders of 2px to 6px in black or acid; one element has no border at all.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: No blur. Hard offset shadows of 6px 6px 0 on 1 or 2 elements only.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Icons are oversized or tiny, with stroke of 2px to 4px; mix a text link, an arrow and a symbol.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Cut-out photography, rough drawings, stickers, scans and 3D renders pasted together.

motion.transition_physics: Jumpy and unpredictable: elements snap between positions in 100ms steps; marquee text scrolls at 20s per loop; hover causes a shift.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover rotates the element by 3° to 6° and swaps its colours; active state inverts the whole block.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels surprise and the sense that a person is playing with the rules.

avoid_when: The product is a transactional or accessibility-critical tool.
The audience needs fast task completion.
The brand needs trust and calm.

modifiers.how: Return to a grid; keep the thick borders, hard shadows and one loud colour.
Strip to default type and links; keep the overlap.
Snap all elements to a 12-column grid and cut to one typeface.

pack.why: A loud, thick, slightly rough line that suits cut-out and sticker art.

ground.why: Anti-design stacks loud blocks off the grid with hard offset shadows.
